about: The public catalog's settings: names only. Nothing here scores, renders or licenses: the download's licence is the library's runtime licence (ops/runtime/runtime.toml), each plate's is its `licence` in plates/manifest.json, the numbers are the scorecard's. Deploy values come from the environment: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, EDGE_ZONE, CATALOG_PUBLIC_BASE, and ITCH_URL once itch, the only store, exists (tools/publish.sh). sponsors_url is the coffee link (GitHub Sponsors), hidden while empty; the priority paragraph shows only while the library's tools/commission-cost.py prints 'falsifier holds' (the-library-as-a-commons step 5).
title: the asset library
